name: Stock and flow
note: The Class XI classroom family for the model structure: a quantity that gathers or loses an amount at flow rates over time. Maths, physics, accounting and geography all reach it (SCHOOL_AND_PROGRESSION.md, Model a system). The method thresholds are chosen: Academics starts at 100,000 milli-XP and the academic_foundation trait adds 10, 25, 45 or 70 XP by rank, so rank 1 has the stock method, rank 2 the rate method and rank 3 the time method.
